summary: After upgrading to 2.6, 2.4 controller PATs keep working with both controller and gateway APIs. In the gateway UI they can be edited or deleted but not created or refreshed; the controller API can still create, edit, delete or refresh them. The UI labels tokens as controller-only or platform.
questions: Do my controller personal access tokens still work after upgrading to 2.6?
Why can't I refresh a controller token in the gateway UI?
How do I tell controller tokens from platform tokens?
Can I use an old controller PAT with the gateway API?
